{{Current events|year=2021|month=12|day=22|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Rojava conflict]]
***Two soldiers and four civilians are killed in clashes between the [[Syrian Democratic Forces|Kurdish SDF]] and the [[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Syrian National Army|SNA]] in [[Tell Tamer]]. [https://english.alaraby.co.uk/news/sdf-and-turkish-backed-forces-clash-northeast-syria (The New Arab)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Hong Kong national security law]]
**The [[University of Hong Kong]] removes the ''[[Pillar of Shame]]'' overnight, a monument dedicated to the victims of the [[1989 Tiananmen Square protests and massacre]] in [[China]]. [https://hongkongfp.com/2021/12/23/breaking-fears-for-condemned-tiananmen-massacre-monument-as-university-of-hong-kong-erects-barricades-around-statue-overnight/ (Hong Kong Free Press)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Jade trade in Myanmar]]
**[[2021 Hpakant jade mine disaster]]
***Dozens of people are missing following a [[landslide]] at a [[jade]] [[mining|mine]] in [[Hpakant]], [[Kachin State]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/dozens-feared-missing-after-landslide-myanmar-jade-mine-2021-12-22 (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Madagascar shipwreck]]
**At least 64 people are confirmed dead following a boat accident off the coast of Antseraka, [[Analanjirofo]], [[Madagascar]], on Monday, with 24 others still missing. [https://www.france24.com/en/afrique/20211222-scores-killed-in-madagascar-boat-accident-dozens-still-missing (France 24)]
**Madagascar's police minister [[Serge Gellé]] is rescued after swimming for 12 hours to shore after his helicopter crashed off the country's northern coast during the boat accident rescue operation. [[President of Madagascar|President]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] hails Gellé's survival. [https://www.dw.com/en/madagascar-minister-swims-12-hours-to-shore-after-helicopter-crash/a-60219728 (Deutsche Welle)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Northern Ireland]]
*****[[Northern Ireland]] reports a record 3,231 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.irishnews.com/news/northernirelandnews/2021/12/22/news/three-deaths-and-3-231-new-covid-19-cases---highest-number-of-daily-cases-reported-in-ni-2542675/ (''The Irish News'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wales]]
*****[[First Minister of Wales|First minister]] [[Mark Drakeford]] announces new restrictions, including limiting the number of people in events to 50 people outdoors and 30 people indoors, no more than six people in a group at bars, restaurants, and cinemas, and imposing a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|face mask mandate]] due to the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. These measures will be in effect beginning on December 26. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-59752752 (BBC News)]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 106,122 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, the first time that the country has reported more than 100,000 new cases in a single day. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-uk-cases-today-latest-b1980902.html (''The Independent'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****The [[Government of Austria|government]] announces a series of new restrictions, including closing restaurants at 10 p.m. beginning on December 27, discourage large-scale New Year's Eve celebrations, capacity restrictions of indoor and outdoor events, and imposing strict entry requirements for travellers from the UK, [[Denmark]], [[Norway]], and the [[Netherlands]] where the Omicron variant is already dominant in an effort to prevent the spread of COVID-19 and its variant. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-business-lifestyle-health-europe-1923dd7fdf69fdfcbd966090ce3bdab5 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****[[Prime Minister of Belgium|Prime Minister]] [[Alexander De Croo]] announces that, due to the spread of the Omicron variant, [[water park]]s, cinemas, theatres and concert halls will be closed, and all indoor events and outdoor events using a tent will be banned. Additionally, shopping will only be allowed in pairs and professional and amateur sport events will be held without spectators. These measures will begin on December 26. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/health/198798/tbtb-live-belgium-strict-rules-cinemas-indoor-events-shopping-sports-christmas (''The Brussels Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Turkey]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Turkey)|Health ministry]] approves the emergency use of the country's first homegrown [[COVID-19 vaccine]] named Turkovac. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/latest-on-coronavirus-outbreak/turkeys-domestic-covid-19-vaccine-turkovac-approved-for-emergency-use/2454638 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]]
*****[[British Columbia]] closes all bars, nightclubs, gyms, fitness centres, and dance studios, and bans all indoor gatherings due to the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/covid-restrictions-bc-dec-21-2021-1.6294027 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Jamaica]]
****[[Jamaica]] reports its first case of the Omicron variant in a person who travelled from the United Kingdom. [https://www.nationnews.com/2021/12/22/jamaica-records-first-case-omicron/ (Nation News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration]] grants [[emergency use authorization]] for [[Pfizer]]'s antiviral COVID-19 oral pill named [[Paxlovid]] for at-risk people over the age of 12 years, becoming the first at-home oral treatment to be approved by the FDA. [https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/fda-authorizes-first-covid-pill-pfizer-emergency-use-rcna8760 (NBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria]]
****[[Nigeria]] destroys 1,066,214 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] with short shelf lives that expired in November. [https://punchng.com/nigeria-destroys-over-one-million-expired-covid-19-vaccines/ (Punch)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
****[[Tunisia]] begins to implement the usage of a mandatory [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 vaccination pass]] in order to enter cafés, state institutions, banks, and shopping centres despite popular opposition and criticism from [[Amnesty International]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/tunisia-introduces-compulsory-vaccine-passes-01640187907 (''Barron's'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****The [[Soroka Medical Center]] in [[Beersheba]] clarifies that the man thought to be [[Israel]]'s first Omicron death had actually had the SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant, following the final laboratory results regarding his condition. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/hospital-reverses-course-says-covid-linked-death-was-delta-not-omicron/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports its first locally transmitted cases of the Omicron variant in three people from [[Osaka Prefecture]] with no international travel history. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/12/22/national/osaka-omicron-community-spread/ (''The Japan Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Western Australia]] 
****[[Western Australia]] will become the first [[States and territories of Australia|state and territory]] to mandate a [[booster dose]] of the COVID-19 vaccine for essential, mining, and healthcare workers, due to the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.news.com.au/national/western-australia/covid19-vaccine-mandate-in-wa-now-includes-a-third-dose/news-story/752c67452adc76f7242228edb500a12e (News.com.au)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela]]
***[[Venezuela]] reports its first seven cases of the Omicron variant in a group of people who had travelled from another country, such as [[Spain]], [[Dominican Republic]], [[Panama]], and Turkey. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/seven-omicron-cases-detected-venezuela-president-says-2021-12-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Animal welfare and rights in Australia]]
**A landowner and an earthmoving business each face 126 [[criminal charge|charges]] for the deaths of 70 [[koala]]s last year at a partially cleared [[tree plantation]] in [[Cape Bridgewater]], [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-59750160 (BBC News)]
*[[Animal welfare and rights in Italy]]
**[[Italy]] bans [[fur farming]] and orders all remaining [[mink]] farms to shut down by June 2022, while a ban on breeding animals for their fur becomes effective immediately. [https://greekreporter.com/2021/12/23/italy-bans-fur/ (Greek Reporter)]
